newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Zhenhua Port plans 100 mln B share IPO this month.
newsitem.headline: Zhenhua Port plans 100 mln B share IPO this month.

text.p: Shanghai Zhenhua Port Machinery Co Ltd plans to launch an initial public offering of 100 million B shares by the end of June for listing on the Shanghai stock exchange, officials said on Wednesday.

Shanghai securities authorities have approved the issue and Zhenhua is waiting for the final go-ahead from the China Securities Regulatory Commission, the top securities watchdog, a Zhenhua official told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
Zhenhua has appointed China Securities Co (CSC) as the lead domestic underwriter and ABN-Amro Hoare Govett the global coordinator, the official said.
Zhenhua plans to use the B share proceeds to expand its core business of making cargo handling equipment for ports, the official said and declined to give further details.
Zhenhua, based in eastern China's metropolis of Shanghai, exports 80 percent of its products to North America and Southeast Asia and sells the remaining 20 percent domestically, a CSC official said.

Zhenhua forecast net profits of 117 million yuan for 1997 against 86 million yuan for last year under international accounting standards, she said, adding it has 235 million outstanding shares held by its founders.
